gitCommit.subject: Feat/ai tool report (#1335)
gitCommit.body:
Feat/ai tool report (#1335)

* feat(ai-tools): implement visibility management for AI tools

- Added `updateAiToolVisibility` function to update the public status of AI tools without triggering full form validation.
- Introduced `VisibilityMultiSelect` component for filtering AI tools by visibility (public/private).
- Enhanced `AiToolActions` component to include visibility toggle functionality.
- Updated `getAdminAiTools` to support visibility filtering in the query.
- Created new API route for handling visibility updates with appropriate error handling.
- Added tests for visibility filtering and management.

This update improves the admin interface for managing AI tools by allowing visibility status changes and filtering based on public/private status.

* feat(ai-tools): add AI tools report page and enhance management interface

- Introduced a new report page for AI tools, allowing administrators to view usage statistics, including user counts, generated images, and videos over selected date ranges.
- Added components for displaying summary cards, ranking lists, and generation trend charts to visualize AI tool performance.
- Enhanced the existing AI tools management interface by adding a report link alongside the tool addition button for improved navigation.
- Implemented responsive design and error handling for data fetching, ensuring a robust user experience.
- Updated translations for new report-related UI elements across multiple languages.

This update significantly enhances the admin interface for managing AI tools by providing comprehensive reporting features and improved usability.

* feat(ai-tools): enhance AI tools report with date range filtering and action dropdown

- Added date range support to the AI tools report component, allowing users to filter data based on selected date ranges.
- Introduced an action dropdown in the AI tool ranking list for viewing generated images, improving user interaction and navigation.
- Updated the admin images page to handle AI tool IDs and date ranges from URL parameters, enhancing data fetching capabilities.
- Enhanced filter controls to include an AI tool selector, streamlining the filtering process for image management.

This update significantly improves the functionality and usability of the AI tools reporting and management interface.

* feat(invitation-codes): enhance invitation code management and filtering

- Introduced `getInvitationCodesForSelectorAction` and `getUserIdByInvitationCodeIdsAction` server actions to streamline invitation code retrieval and user ID resolution.
- Added `InvitationCodeSelector` component for selecting invitation codes, improving user experience in filtering and managing codes.
- Updated various admin pages (images, videos, reports) to integrate invitation code filtering, enhancing data fetching and user interaction.
- Enhanced AI tools report and image generation report pages to utilize effective user IDs derived from invitation codes, improving data accuracy.

This update significantly improves the functionality and usability of the invitation code management system, providing better filtering options and user feedback.

* fix: lint error

* feat(ai-tools): enhance user and invitation code filtering in AI tools management

- Integrated `UserSelector` and `InvitationCodeSelector` components into the AI tools search form and report client, allowing for improved filtering based on user IDs and invitation codes.
- Updated the `getAdminAiTools` function to support filtering by effective user IDs derived from invitation codes, enhancing data accuracy in AI tools management.
- Refactored effective user ID logic across various components to streamline user and invitation code handling, ensuring consistent data fetching and improved user experience.

This update significantly enhances the functionality and usability of the AI tools management interface by providing better filtering options and user feedback.

* feat(images): implement download ZIP functionality for image generations

- Added a new `DownloadZipDialog` component to facilitate downloading selected images as a ZIP file, enhancing user experience in image management.
- Implemented API routes for generating download summaries and handling ZIP file creation, ensuring robust error handling and permission checks.
- Integrated new state management logic to handle user selections and filter conditions for the download process.
- Updated translations for new UI elements related to the download feature across multiple languages.

This update significantly improves the functionality of the admin images page by providing a streamlined method for downloading images, enhancing usability and efficiency.

* refactor(ai-tools): improve AI tools report component structure and enhance filtering

- Updated the import statement for `AiToolsReportClient` to use named imports for better clarity.
- Refactored the `AiToolsReportClient` component to utilize the new `AiToolsReportFilters` component, streamlining the filtering process for date ranges and user selections.
- Removed unused imports and components to clean up the codebase, enhancing maintainability.
- Improved the `AiToolRankingList` component by replacing the custom `OutputTypeBadgeClient` with the more efficient `OutputTypeBadge` component.

This update enhances the structure and readability of the AI tools report components, improving the overall user experience and maintainability of the codebase.

* refactor(ai-tools): enhance AI tool ranking list and report filters for improved layout

- Updated the `AiToolRankingList` component to use more descriptive keys for skeleton loading elements, enhancing readability.
- Refined table header classes in `AiToolRankingList` to ensure consistent styling and improved responsiveness.
- Adjusted layout in `AiToolsReportFilters` to optimize flex properties, ensuring better alignment and spacing across different screen sizes.

These changes improve the overall user experience and maintainability of the AI tools report components by enhancing layout consistency and clarity.

* feat(images): enhance image generation report with user ranking and base model distribution

- Introduced `UserGenerationRankingList` and `BaseModelRankingList` components to display user generation rankings and base model distribution, improving data visibility.
- Updated the `ImageGenerationReportPage` to integrate new ranking lists, allowing for better insights into user activity and model performance.
- Enhanced data fetching logic with new queries for user rankings and base model statistics, ensuring accurate and timely data presentation.
- Improved translations for new UI elements related to user rankings and base model distribution across multiple languages.

This update significantly enhances the functionality and usability of the image generation report, providing administrators with valuable insights into user engagement and model performance.

* feat(ai-tools): add user AI tool usage ranking and enhance report components

- Introduced `UserAiToolUsageRankingList` component to display user rankings based on AI tool usage, improving insights into user engagement.
- Updated `AiToolsReportClient` to integrate user usage ranking alongside existing report elements, enhancing data visibility.
- Enhanced `AiToolSummaryCards` and `AiToolRankingList` components to include new metrics such as unused tools count and AI tool share of total, providing a more comprehensive overview of AI tool performance.
- Improved data fetching logic with new queries for user rankings and additional statistics, ensuring accurate and timely data presentation.

This update significantly enhances the functionality and usability of the AI tools report, providing administrators with valuable insights into user activity and tool performance.

* feat(users): enhance user management with invitation codes and user actions

- Added `InvitationCodesCell` to display the count and codes of invitation codes used by users in the `UserTableRow` component, improving visibility of user engagement.
- Updated `UsersTable` to include a new table header for invitation codes, enhancing the data structure.
- Introduced `viewUserManagementAction` in `UserGenerationRankingList` to allow administrators to view user management details directly from the ranking list, streamlining user management processes.
- Improved translations for new UI elements related to invitation codes and user management across multiple languages.

This update significantly enhances the user management interface by providing better insights into invitation code usage and facilitating user management actions.
